notes.title: Balancing & library update
notes.content:
June 12th, 2016: Included a physics "raytest" crashfix that was pushed to 5089 in 4089. No reports of it happening in 4089, but it may have been possible.

June 8th, 2016: I'm bumping player health by 50%. 4089 is meant to be very challenging, but the low health was borderline frustrating -- this should help clear that up. To those who still like a great challenge, permadeath is right up your ally.

As I continue to work on my latest title, 5089, I'll be porting any applicable virtual reality & engine updates here. This latest one brings OpenVR to v1.0 & includes the latest jMonkeyEngine, LWJGL & GLFW builds.

notes.title: Launch Update on Windows
notes.content:
4089 will now first try using your Java installation, just in case you have a 32-bit system or a newer version of the Java runtime. If no Java version is detected, the included 64-bit Java will be used.

If the included Java version doesn't work for you, or if your Java version is outdated, install the latest here:

http://www.java.com/getjava

notes.title: VR Update & no more Java install on Windows!
notes.content:
v1.142: 4089 now uses OpenVR & should be compatible with Oculus v0.6.0.1. It should also work on Linux & Mac, if running a compatible Oculus runtime. Also, since it is using OpenVR, 4089 should now be compatible with Vive & other VR headsets.

Also, 4089 now bundles Java with Windows -- no more individual install required!

VR supoort is very good, but I have a few quirks that still need some tweaking:

1) A VR mouse pointer works, but the standard system cursor still displays. I'm working at hiding it.

[strike]2) Your weapon will move inconsistently depending on which way you are turned. You will still be able to aim & play fine, but it won't appear "stuck to your head".[/strike]

v1.143: Fixed weapon inconsistencies. It still moves a bit with your head, but I think it is pretty cool than being completely fixed. :P Also fixed a naming issue with jme3-bullet-natives on Linux.

v1.144: Better VR support! Reduced latency & frame skipping. GUI is better centered.

tags.feature: Also, 4089 now bundles Java with Windows -- no more individual install required!

tags.bug: - Fixed weapon inconsistencies.

tags.balance_change: - Reduced latency & frame skipping.

notes.title: 4089 v1.132: better mod support!
notes.content:
Thanks to your suggestions & reports, 4089 got some better mod support! Here are the changes in v1.132:
[list]
[*]Robots from your selected modification directory will now be included correctly
[*]Added “disable_hover_effect” in Robot text files to remove the yellow hover effect from non-flying robots
[*]Added optional “multishot” variable to weapon item files: allows creation of shotguns. See “Items/slowgun.txt” for a commented example
[/list]
Special thanks to [OSA]hipp0cat for his awesome creations. You should check out his new "Death Head" mod here:

http://steamcommunity.com/app/329770/discussions/0/622954747290448596/

- Phr00t

notes.title: Free key giveaway, v1.128 update & "Next Game" survey!
notes.content:
Lots is happening with 4089 and Phr00t's Software! Make sure to "Like" Phr00t's Software & take the quick 4089 quiz to enter to win a 4089 key!

http://tab.fo/4cpcvyr

Big 4089: Ghost Within update -- special thanks to darkmetalknight & Misery for testing this version before release. New "Limited Lives" game mode will allow you to keep all your stat points on death, but you only get 4 lives & then the game ends. There also is a new "Set Mod Folder" option, where you can set which directory to pull extra or modified content from. This way, you can pick and choose content easily without having to put all user content among the official 4089 content.

[b]All v1.126 changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]New game mode: limited lives mode (don’t lose skill points at death, but only 4 lives)
[*]Renamed “Challenge” mode to “Permadeath” mode
[*]Renamed “Adventure” mode to “Normal” mode
[*]Added option to set modification directories, so you don’t need to put all mods into the base directories
[*]Added cover to the grand halls
[*]Enemies shouldn’t spawn near player anymore in open rooms
[*]Performance improvements made by reducing polygon count in some areas
[*]“force_special” weapon variable will be limited to +3
[*]Alt-fire fired weapons will use offset values from alternate item
[*]Overlord subtitles typo fixed
[/list]
[b]v1.128 changes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hopefully fixed library extraction & crash problems on Mac
[*]Rooms/Includes should now properly be used when a mod directory is set
[*]Room Viewer now should update when files are changed in the set mod directory
[*]Slightly increased the damage output of the "Uber Iris Gun"
[*]Fixed a stack overflow crash associated with the Linux launcher
[/list]
While I complete 4089, I like to plan ahead for the "Next Game" & I want to know -- what is important to you in a future game?

https://www.surveymonkey.com/s/FPGC9BW

Thank you all for your support!
- Phr00t

notes.title: 4089 v1.124: Difficulty tweaks, joystick fixes & more!
notes.content:
Thank you for the feedback! I increased the number of stat points found in the world, which should help you better prepare your character for the later parts of the game. It should also allow you to diversify points better & replace lost points when dying.

I also increased the controller "deadzone" which should hopefully resolve wandering problems with XBox360 & PS3 controllers.

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*]Increased stat point pickups: should help in growing your character & smooth difficulty later in the game
[*]"Deadzone" controller fixes (hopefully should fix XBox360/PS3 controller issues)
[*]Remapped controller keys to more traditional console FPS layouts
[*]Added an option to adjust Field of View
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Overlord to not spawn after being killed near it
[*]Now you can specify a special power when creating weapons, see "Items/gun.txt" for an example
[*]Fixed a bug that caused lobbed grenades to not be rotated correctly when fired
[*]Hopefully addressed an issue on Macs with library extraction
[/list]

notes.title: 4089 v1.121: Joystick, Rift fixes & more!
notes.content:
Hey guys,

Thank you all for the feedback and support. I've been working hard these past few days to get these fixes & improvements to you. This version should provide a much better joystick experience, which is also very important for Oculus Rift users! Artificial intelligence has been improved too, so enemies should be able to track you down room to room better.

Special thanks to BARUCK OBUMA for creating a custom room -- I've integrated it into the main distribution!

Full list of changes:
[list]
[*]Fixed many joystick issues (“deadzone” problem, button mapping, movement, constant rotating…)
[*]New room design taken from BARUCK OBUMA on Steam
[*]You can now use the 1, 2 & 3 keys to select weapons
[*]Fixed many Oculus Rift bugs, like the inventory screen being too close & big
[*]Tweaked movement speed of enemies & player
[*]Fixed “beam_alpha” typo in weapon text files
[*]Added more options for the Overlord voice (Text Only, Audio only)
[*]Fixed AI problems picking doors to go through
[*]Other minor performance / reliability tweaks
[/list]
